description: Simulated book (PRD success metric): 40 loans over 2026, ten each on_time, chronic_late (3-26 days late, the last payment the quote), payoff_early (quote 10-19 days after installment 2-4) and default (0-2 payments, then none). Run day by day: create loans on their disbursement day, accrual, the late-fee job, then payments. States are transitions (a new row only when the state changes). D23: a repaid loan is closed, current, and takes no fee.
